name: token-usage
description: One line above the prompt: context use, usage limits, main and subagent models with effort. Click a subagent name to open its work pane

band.title: Usage line above the prompt
band.description: Shows context (conversation memory) use, usage limits and models in one line above the prompt. When off, /token-usage still opens the details.

resetTimes.title: Usage limit reset times
resetTimes.description: Adds the time left until the 5h and 7d usage limits refill (↻2h).

agentRows.title: Subagent rows
agentRows.description: How many subagents get their own row above the prompt. The rest fold into '+N more'.

agentActivity.title: What subagents are looking at
agentActivity.description: Shows the last file opened or command run at the end of each subagent row.

theme.title: Color theme
theme.description: 'theme file' uses the theme picked with /token-usage theme (mods-theme.json).
